name: Interlocutory applications and written submissions
one_line: THE REQUEST-AND-ARGUMENT APPARATUS a practitioner files to obtain an order: a labelled relief-sought or orders-sought slot, a numbered argument carrying a self-referential TABLE OF AUTHORITIES with page back-references, a labelled LENGTH ATTESTATION, a RETURN-DATE slot that schedules the determination of the document carrying it, an explicit BRIEFING-SEQUENCE cross-reference naming another filing by its own filing identifier, and an enclosed PROPOSED ORDER - an instrument-shaped document bearing a live caption whose judicial execution block is deliberately BLANK. Not a document-type word, not a length, not a lifecycle stage: the roster hint's 'short of the final outcome' framing is EMPIRICALLY WRONG and this row repairs it (see NJ-MB-1), because a summary-judgment motion is dispositive and a post-trial motion follows the final outcome, yet both carry the identical apparatus. The row exists on ONE leg of the node test and concedes the other two: its DETECTION SIGNALS are additive to and disjoint from the schema's eleven defaults, none of which covers a filed submission; its dimensions are empty for the schema's own three reasons and differ in nothing; its privacy posture is the schema's, unchanged. The apparatus is precisely what `legal` cannot see - `legal` fires on a bound party pair, a notarial block or a tribunal caption, and a back-reference table, a word-count attestation, a return date and a blank judicial signature line are none of the three. The caption on the same page IS `legal`'s, is conceded whole, and its safety protection runs first.

deterministic: PRECONDITION, INHERITED WHOLE AND NOT RESTATED AS A NEW CLAIM. Nothing below fires unless the `law_practice` schema's own two-leg default has already fired - an exact matter, file or engagement reference repeated across two or more artefacts, together with at least one artefact whose own labelled slots separate a practitioner or firm role from a client role. Every signal in this list is an ADDITION to that precondition and none substitutes for it. The schema's deletion test governs unchanged: delete every entity name and every document-type word, and if nothing structural survives, nothing fires. This row was written to survive that test, and what survives it is the six-item apparatus below - never the word motion, never the caption, never a filename.

A LABELLED RELIEF-SOUGHT OR ORDERS-SOUGHT SLOT: a heading zone or enumerated block whose own label announces what the tribunal is being asked to ORDER, followed by discrete numbered requests written in the imperative or the subjunctive. This is the row's primary operative structure and it is read through 00's direct-fact path, "a labeled form field": the label is on the page, and what it labels is a request rather than an allegation. A prayer running in prose at the foot of an assertion document is NOT this slot - that is the pleadings pattern, which is refused and falls to `legal`.

AN ENCLOSED PROPOSED ORDER: a separate document, or a separately paginated tail section, that is instrument-shaped - a caption, decretal paragraphs, an ordering formula - and whose EXECUTION BLOCK IS BLANK: an unnamed judicial signature line, an empty date line, sometimes a bracketed judge placeholder. This is the family's most discriminating single artefact because it is a THREE-WAY inverse: `legal` fires on a bound party pair PLUS execution and this document has execution deliberately empty; `law_practice.orders-and-judgments` owns the same instrument once it is signed, dated, entered and sealed; `law_practice.precedent-bank` owns unexecuted instruments that carry NO caption and NO live proceeding. Blank execution PLUS a live caption is a combination no other row in the roster produces.

A TABLE OF AUTHORITIES WITH PAGE BACK-REFERENCES: a table whose rows are citations - cases, statutes, rules, secondary sources, usually sectioned under those headings - and whose right-hand column is a set of page numbers pointing back into the SAME document. It is a self-referential index, which is a structure rather than a subject: a bibliography, a reading list and a research memo's authorities list all cite, but none of them indexes its own pages. Read through 00's table path, since the row's evidence is the table-like region itself and not the citations in it. On its own it is never-alone; it fires only beside a captioned proceeding identifier.

A LABELLED LENGTH ATTESTATION - a certificate of compliance, a word-count or page-count certificate, a statement of length - carrying a COUNT in a labelled slot and co-occurring with a captioned case identifier. STATED CAREFULLY BECAUSE A LENGTH IS ON THE REFUSAL LIST: the row does not claim documents by how long they are and a word count is a value, not a node. What is evidence here is the ATTESTATION SLOT - a labelled assertion, made to a tribunal, that a limit was observed - which no other artefact in this family or its neighbours produces at all.

A RETURN-DATE OR NOTICE-OF-HEARING SLOT ON THE DOCUMENT'S OWN FACE: labelled date, time, and court or judge location, stating when THIS document will be determined. It is structurally unlike a diary entry and must not be confused with one: the schema's key-date signal is a PORTFOLIO TABLE over many matters with an owning-practitioner column, and this is a single forward-looking slot inside one filed instrument. The product calculates, validates and acts on no date; the slot is evidence of the artefact's kind and nothing else.

A BRIEFING-SEQUENCE CROSS-REFERENCE: a labelled slot or title line identifying, by its own FILING IDENTIFIER - docket entry number, filing date, application notice number - the document this one answers or replies to. Two documents by ADVERSARIAL authors bound into one operative exchange is a relation no version_family or matter anchor expresses. Where present it is also this row's grouping anchor; where absent, a shared caption never substitutes for it.

A SUPPORTING SWORN OR VERIFIED STATEMENT BOUND TO A REQUEST: a declaration or affidavit whose own header states that it is made IN SUPPORT OF a named request, with a jurat or statement-of-truth block and, commonly, tabbed exhibits. The binding phrase in the header is the evidence. THE EXHIBITS ARE NOT THIS ROW'S - `law_practice.evidence-exhibits` owns each exhibit on its own tab and its own document nature, and this row owns only the statement's binding header, exactly as `law_practice.appeals` owns a record index without owning its members.

A NON-US EQUIVALENT SET, recorded so the row does not become a jurisdiction-shaped artefact of one court system: an APPLICATION NOTICE pairing an order-sought slot with a hearing-length estimate and a with-notice or without-notice marker, a SKELETON ARGUMENT with numbered submissions and an authorities bundle index, and a DRAFT ORDER annexed. The apparatus is the same six items under different labels. This row defines no court list, no jurisdiction catalogue and no procedural rule; where the labelled slots are not recognisable, the route is local interpretation or abstention.

AN ARCHIVE whose manifest, READ WITHOUT UNPACKING, shows member paths encoding one request package - a request document, a memorandum, a supporting declaration, exhibit members, a proposed order, a certificate of service - under one repeated matter or docket reference. Member paths are observations and become facts on no member; the certificate of service member is `law_practice.court-filing-record`'s on its own evidence and this row does not claim it.
needs_llm: DECIDING WHETHER THE APPARATUS BELONGS TO A LIVE MATTER OR TO A TEACHING COPY. This is the row's sharpest over-firing risk and its collision fixture: the profession publishes its own model motions, and a Trial Advocacy or CLE exemplar carries a caption, a relief slot, a numbered argument and a table of authorities - every structural item this row claims. Only 00's purpose test separates them, since "purpose answers what the file was for", and the operative discriminator is the schema precondition: a real matter reference recurring across artefacts, and a counsel block naming the holder's own firm.

SEPARATING A REQUEST DOCUMENT FROM AN ASSERTION DOCUMENT when the labels are unhelpful, which is common in unlabelled or translated practice. A statement of case asserts the parties' own allegations and closes on a prayer; a request document asks the tribunal to order something and argues for it. Where neither the relief slot nor the assertion structure is legible, the model abstains and the caption alone carries the file to `legal`.

SEPARATING THIS ROW FROM `law_practice.appeals` WHERE THE TIER IS THE ONLY DIFFERENCE. An appellate stay, extension-of-time or expedition application is a request document in every structural respect; the landed neighbour claims it on the two-tier proceeding-identifier pair and this row concedes it. The model must read the heading zone for a second, lower proceeding identifier and an on-appeal-from line, not the word motion.

SEPARATING THE FILED SUBMISSION FROM THE INTERNAL RESEARCH THAT BECAME IT. Ninety per cent of the text can be identical. Only the apparatus differs - caption, relief slot, authorities table, attestation - and where a draft carries none of it yet, `law_practice.legal-research` holds it and this row does not.

DECIDING WHETHER A PROPOSED ORDER IS AN ENCLOSURE OR A PRECEDENT. A blank-execution instrument with a caption is this row's; a blank-execution instrument with bracketed placeholders where parties belong and no live proceeding is `law_practice.precedent-bank`'s. A firm that keeps a caption-bearing standard-form order in its know-how bank defeats the test on the bytes alone, and the model must abstain rather than guess.

ABSTAINING WHENEVER THE MATTER-AND-ROLE PRECONDITION CANNOT BE CITED, however complete the apparatus looks. A downloaded public filing satisfies every structural item on this list and establishes nothing about the holder; correct abstention is the successful outcome here and the row is written to make abstention easy rather than to maximise capture.
never_alone: THE WORDS MOTION, APPLICATION, BRIEF, MEMORANDUM, SUBMISSION, PETITION, OPPOSITION, RESPONSE, REPLY, SKELETON or ORDER. These are the row's own subject matter and they are struck FIRST, because a row justified by a document-type word is the schema's default template with a narrower filename filter. They are values of `work_type`, not evidence.

A TRIBUNAL CAPTION, A PARTY PAIR, A CASE OR DOCKET NUMBER, OR A FILED STAMP. The caption is `legal`'s deterministic signal, is satisfied identically by a public filing anyone downloaded, and is the exact evidence on which the sibling `law_practice.pleadings` was REFUSED. This row concedes it whole and claims nothing from it; the caption is a precondition-adjacent context for the apparatus, never the apparatus.

A TABLE OF AUTHORITIES, CITATION TABLE, BIBLIOGRAPHY OR AUTHORITIES BUNDLE INDEX ALONE. A casebook, a law-review article, a practice note, a student paper and a research memo all carry citation tables. The signal is the self-referential page back-reference CO-OCCURRING with a captioned proceeding identifier, and neither half fires by itself.
A WORD COUNT, PAGE COUNT OR LENGTH STATEMENT ALONE. A length is not a node and not a fact here. Manuscripts, dissertations, grant applications and editorial submissions all attest to length.

A HEARING DATE, RETURN DATE, TIME OR COURTROOM ALONE, in any source type including `calendar`. A date is a date; the schema's diary signal is a portfolio table and this row's signal is a labelled slot inside a filed instrument. Neither is satisfied by an `.ics` event or a filename containing a date.

A BLANK SIGNATURE LINE ALONE. Every unexecuted draft in every domain has one. It is evidence only in combination with a LIVE caption, which is what separates an enclosed proposed order from a precedent-bank standard form.

A LAW-FIRM, COURT, JUDGE, COUNSEL, PARTY or CLIENT NAME, A PRACTISING-CERTIFICATE OR BAR REFERENCE, A PRACTICE-AREA WORD, OR ANY COMBINATION OF THEM. Inherited from the schema unchanged and not re-argued: a role name cannot carry a schema and cannot carry a template either.

A CONFIDENTIAL, PRIVILEGED, SEALED, UNDER-SEAL, EX-PARTE or WITHOUT-PREJUDICE LABEL. Preserved as a literal observation. The product decides no legal status, no sealing, no service, no notice adequacy and no procedural validity, and specifically an under-seal marking is not evidence that this row applies.
PUBLIC AVAILABILITY OF THE FILING ON A DOCKET as proof that the local copy, its neighbours, its folder label or its surrounding matter context are low-sensitivity or eligible for a cloud prompt.

A FILENAME OR FOLDER containing motion, brief, application, filings, pleadings, proposed, draft or final, and DOWNLOAD-SESSION, THREAD OR CURRENT-DIRECTORY MEMBERSHIP. A folder named Motions is an unlabelled position; a session is not a proceeding.

AUTHOR, CREATOR, PRODUCER OR LAST-SAVED-BY METADATA naming a practitioner, a firm or a brief-assembly or citation tool. 00: "It should avoid using authorship or creator identity as a destination dimension", and litigation-support software writes those slots on exemplars and live filings alike.
A SOURCE TYPE OR EXTENSION ALONE. `file_kind_plausible` is constitutionally never-alone and every extension this row lists is shared with material that has nothing to do with it.

work_types: notice of motion or application notice with an enumerated relief request
memorandum of points and authorities or written submission in support
skeleton argument and outline of submissions
declaration, affidavit or witness statement made in support of a request
separate statement or statement of disputed facts served with a request
table of authorities and authorities bundle index
certificate of compliance or length attestation
proposed, draft or minute order enclosed with a request
without-notice, ex parte or urgent interim application and its declaration of urgency
order to show cause and its supporting papers
request package archive or document-assembly output
grouping_reasons: ONE REQUEST PACKAGE: the request document, its memorandum or submission, its supporting declaration, its separate statement, its authorities table and its proposed order, joined by ONE explicit relief request and, where present, one filing or docket-entry identifier. Content-incoherent and purpose-coherent, which is 00's own licence for such a group - "The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent." The package anchor supports candidate membership and copies no party, relief, date or outcome fact onto any member.

ONE BRIEFING SEQUENCE: the moving submission, the opposition and the reply, joined ONLY by an explicit cross-reference naming another filing by its own filing identifier. This is the row's strongest grouping anchor precisely because it is authored by ADVERSARIAL parties, so no authorship or firm signal can produce it accidentally.

ONE DOCUMENT ACROSS ITS DRAFTS AND ITS FILED COPY - the universal version_family fact, supported by hashes or explicit revision markers, never by a `-final` suffix and never by a filed stamp, which belongs to `law_practice.court-filing-record` as its own evidence.

NOT GROUPING REASONS, STATED BECAUSE THE MISFIRING ANCHOR HERE IS OBVIOUS AND SEDUCTIVE: a SHARED CAPTION groups nothing. Every filing in a proceeding carries it, including the pleadings, the orders, the discovery instruments and the transcripts, none of which are this row's; a caption-joined group is a proceeding, not a package. Equally excluded: a shared hearing date, a shared party or judge name, a shared practice area, a common firm, a download session, and a folder named for a document type. 00 governs: "It should not form a supported group when there is no valid anchor".
NO GROUP AT ALL is a valid and common outcome. A single opposition brief with no package around it is still protected material and still routes to Protected Records.

template.why: EMPTY FOR THE SCHEMA'S THREE REASONS, WHICH THIS ROW INHERITS AND DOES NOT RE-ARGUE: no field is declared to branch on (D1 as narrowed, PR-6, _CONTRACT rules 10 and 15); the material co-activates `legal`, and 00 states "Finance, identity, medical, and legal material should be implemented first as safety domains", so no deep template unlocks from safety activation; and the natural dimensions of this world - a client and a matter - are themselves disclosures. THIS ROW CONCEDES THE SECOND LEG OF THE NODE TEST IN FULL AND SAYS SO PLAINLY: its recommended order does not differ from the schema's default, and it would not differ if PR-6 lifted. Held as prose, the schema's recommendation is the client only where the corpus spans more than one AND the user has explicitly approved a client-named branch, then the matter, then the document function, then the period last - and THIS ROW IS ONE VALUE AT THE FUNCTION LEVEL, not a level of its own. Function must follow the matter for 00's own reason, "A work type such as Homework 3 is meaningful only after the course is known": an opposition is unintelligible without the request it opposes, and the request is unintelligible without the matter. NOT TIME-FIRST: filing time, hearing time, document date and filesystem time mean four different things here and nothing in this world is capture-based. The two additions this row would make if fields ever landed are prohibitions rather than dimensions - a HEARING OR RETURN DATE may never become a level, because it is the one date in this family the product is most likely to be asked to act on and it must not be structurally privileged, and a NAMED THIRD PARTY may never become one, because an emergency application names a child.

collides_with.signal: SAME FIXTURE BOTH SIDES: a court-captioned, numbered-paragraph, counsel-signed document filed in `Hartley v Nash` and sitting in the same folder as the amended statement of case - caption, party pair, paragraph numbering and signature block are identical on both, and the neighbour authored this edge from its side in the same words. THIS ROW OWNS the document only where the APPARATUS is present: a labelled orders-sought slot addressed to the tribunal, an argument with a self-referential table of authorities, a length attestation, or an enclosed blank-execution proposed order. THE NEIGHBOUR OWNS a document whose numbered paragraphs assert the parties' own allegations or responses and close on a prayer for final relief - EXCEPT THAT THE NEIGHBOUR IS REFUSED, so that pattern counts toward `legal` on the caption's own evidence and toward nothing here. The discriminating evidence is therefore the apparatus versus the assertion structure, and where neither is legible the shared caption supports `legal` alone.

SAME FIXTURE BOTH SIDES: `Motion for extension of time to file opening brief - 24-1187.pdf`, and one written submission carrying a table of contents, a table of authorities with page back-references, a certificate of compliance and a captioned counsel signature block. The neighbour authored this edge first and this row adopts its discriminator without weakening it. THE NEIGHBOUR OWNS the file wherever the heading zone carries the TWO-TIER PROCEEDING-IDENTIFIER PAIR - an appellate docket number in caption position plus a separately labelled on-appeal-from line naming the court, case number and dated decision below - or a labelled STANDARD OF REVIEW section. THIS ROW OWNS it only at a single tier, where the document asks for something not yet decided. THE HARD HALF, conceded rather than smoothed: an appellate stay, extension or expedition application carries this row's complete apparatus and still goes to the neighbour, because the tier pair decides and the apparatus is not decisive there. Second competition: a first-instance motion reproduced INSIDE a record on appeal stays this row's, because appendix membership lives on the compilation's index and never on the member.

SAME FIXTURE BOTH SIDES: `[PROPOSED] Order Granting Motion to Compel - 41127-0006.docx` and the signed order that later issues from it - same caption, same decretal paragraphs, frequently the same lineage of bytes. THIS ROW OWNS the copy whose EXECUTION BLOCK IS BLANK: unnamed judicial signature line, empty date, no seal, no entry stamp, and enclosed with a request. THE NEIGHBOUR OWNS the copy once ANY of signature, judicial name, entry date or seal is present. Discriminated by the execution block alone, never by the word PROPOSED or DRAFT in the filename, which appears on both when a firm names its file copy of the signed order after the draft it submitted.

SAME FIXTURE BOTH SIDES: `Motion to Compel Production - FILED 2026-08-20.pdf`, which recites the neighbour's numbered requests at length; the neighbour authored this edge from its side. THIS ROW OWNS the argument-and-relief apparatus - orders-sought slot, numbered argument, table of authorities, meet-and-confer declaration, proposed order - and owns the motion whole even though most of its page count is quoted demands. THE NEIGHBOUR OWNS the demand instrument and the responses themselves, which are served rather than filed and carry no argument structure, together with the review log, the withholding schedule and the load file. A protective-order APPLICATION is this row's; the order that issues on it is `law_practice.orders-and-judgments`'; neither row claims the other's.

SAME FIXTURE BOTH SIDES: one PDF of the filed motion bearing an electronic-filing stamp header across page one and a certificate of service on its last page. The neighbour's memo already states the split from its side - the document that was filed is not its evidence, because nothing in the document's body records a transmission. THIS ROW OWNS the body and its apparatus. THE NEIGHBOUR OWNS the stamp, the submission identifier, the timestamp, the certificate of service and the notice-of-electronic-filing email, and owns them even when they are printed on this row's page. Discriminated by whether the item records a REQUEST or a TRANSMISSION; a filed stamp is never this row's evidence and never promotes a draft.

SAME FIXTURE BOTH SIDES: `Research memo - can we compel the Set One responses - 41127-0006.docx`, whose text is roughly ninety per cent identical to the filed memorandum of points and authorities and which sits in the same matter folder.
